name: CWallpaper
description: A moving wallpaper and matching colors for the whole app: Kiki (pixel art of a young witch and her black cat floating on a broom toward a seaside city, following your clock from day to sunset to night) or a black hole in ASCII art drawn by code (a gold ring, its disc bent over and under it, everything streaming in). Its settings are the plugin's options; /cwallpaper settings opens them in a pane.

on.title: Wallpaper: on
on.description: Show the wallpaper and its colors, or leave the app its own look.

motion.title: Motion
motion.description: How the wallpaper moves: smooth (all of it), light (calmer: Kiki's shooting star rests, the black hole turns more slowly) or off (still).

clear.title: Panels: how clear
clear.description: How see-through the app panels are over the wallpaper: 0 is solid, 100 is clear.

blur.title: Panels: blur
blur.description: How far the panels blur the wallpaper behind them, 0 to 40.

dim.title: Scene: dim
dim.description: How much the wallpaper itself is darkened so words stand clear of it, 0 to 80.

colors.title: App colors follow the wallpaper
colors.description: Repaint the app in colors that match the wallpaper.

kikiTime.title: Kiki: time of day
kikiTime.description: Which part of the day Kiki shows: auto follows the clock (sunrise at 06:30, sunset at 18:30), or always day, sunset or night.

kikiSpinner.title: Kiki: cat spinner
kikiSpinner.description: Adds a small cat face to the line that shows while Claude works, while Kiki is the wallpaper.

blackholeSize.title: Black hole: size
blackholeSize.description: How large the black hole is drawn over the chat column: small, medium or large.

blackholeCalm.title: Black hole: calmer motion
blackholeCalm.description: Slows and softens the black hole: the disc streams more gently, fewer streaks and clumps, dimmer matter falling in.
